# SEO-227: Declare intrinsic dimensions on rendered images

This page is generated from the canonical JSONL registry record. Edit the JSONL record and run `npm run docs -- --write`; do not edit this file directly.

| Domain | `images` |

## Statement

Every image element declares width and height attributes matching the asset's intrinsic pixel dimensions, or a framework component that emits them on its behalf, so the space the image will occupy is known before it loads.

## Rationale

Without declared dimensions the browser cannot reserve space, so the content below the image moves once it arrives, and the reader loses their place through no action of their own.

## Applicability

```json
{
  "all": [
    "public_site"
  ],
  "any": [
    "has_images"
  ]
}
```

## Implementation

Read the dimensions from the asset at build time rather than hand-writing them, and set the aspect ratio in CSS so a responsive width still reserves the right height. Do not copy the displayed size into the attributes when it differs from the file.

## Verification

- Level: `SOURCE_AND_RUNTIME`
- Method: Compare each declared width and height against the intrinsic dimensions of the fetched asset and report images with absent or mismatched values.
- Evidence: `RENDERED_HTML`, `BROWSER`, `PERFORMANCE_MEASUREMENT`
- Automated check: `img-dimensions-declared`
